description:
Get the result of a scan started with scan_website (waits up to 60 seconds if it is still running). Scans are kept 30 days.

    Args:
        scan_id: the identifier returned by scan_website.
        sector: "vente-en-ligne", "immobilier" or "entreprise"; guessed when omitted.
        lang: "fr" or "en".
name: get_scan_result
